You only got cash from them if they were killed in this map, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gotten was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed or damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreased by 25%, which meant that in a quad, you only got 25% of the cash. This amount is distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which was 12.5% in duo, 16.7% in trio and 18.75% in quad. took place on a desert surrounded by a few grassy areas and mountains, separated by a giant river. Multiple cactuses and trees were scattered across the map. On the map there were multiple black roads with yellow lines and grey sidewalk. There were two bridges on this map, one large red bridge connecting two hills and a smaller brown bridge. There was a yellow house with a red roof and blue floor on this map. There was also a white lighthouse with black stripes.

As the waves progressed, the map slowly became corrupted by the Korblox forces, starting from the portal. The corruption was destroyed upon triumphing, though the map got fully corrupted upon loss. The ground turned purple and black. Trees and cactuses turned into translucent blue dead trees. A few objects started floating in the air. Additionally, the skybox also gets corrupted with waves.
